summary: PM-AI-REPAIR-001 Health Repair Engine tested end-to-end. Backend (9/9 pytest passed): auth guards on all 3 endpoints (401/403), GET /status returns all 11 domains with score/warning_threshold/has_engine/last_repair + last_run + runs_total, GET /runs?limit=5 returns history with at least one full 11-domain run, POST /run validates invalid/empty domains (400), POST /run with {domains:['technical_debt']} returns {started:true} and a new manual:... run appears in <90s with technical_debt result containing problems/actions/score_before/score_after/delta. Orchestrator ledger contains playbook_id=health_repair_engine entry. Frontend: /admin/repair-center loads, grid renders all 11 domain cards (data-testid='repair-domain-<key>'), repair-last-run visible, clicking repair-run-technical_debt shows '⏳ Ciclul rulează în fundal' then '✅ Ciclu finalizat...' in repair-message within ~5s, 'Enterprise Health' link (repair-to-health) navigates to /admin/enterprise-health without 404, and regression /admin/orchestrator still renders governance-snapshot.

issues: Because /status computes last_repair from ONLY the most recent run's results, after a per-domain run (e.g. technical_debt) all other domain cards display 'Nicio reparație încă' — losing visibility on the earlier full-run repairs. Consider aggregating last_repair per domain across all recent runs so cards keep showing their most recent detect/repair result.

action_items: (Optional UX) In routes/repair_center.py::repair_status, build last_by_domain from the latest run PER domain (not only from the single most-recent run) so per-domain cards keep showing their last repair after a targeted run.
critical_code_review_comments: repair_center.py POST /run: asyncio.create_task on run_repair_cycle is fire-and-forget without exception logging — a failing background cycle would silently disappear. Wrap in a task that logs exceptions.
GET /status is expensive (~10-20s live metrics collection); consider caching or ETag/If-None-Match to avoid repeated heavy work when UI polls.
No rate-limit / lock on POST /run — a user could spawn many concurrent cycles. Consider a Mongo lock (e.g. running flag) to serialize.
seed_data_creation: None. Triggered one live technical_debt repair run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repair Engine fully green. Domain card 'last_repair' only reflects the single latest run — flagged as UX improvement, not a bug. Endpoint /status is slow (~10-20s), use timeout>=30s. Login button in RO UI is 'Conectează-te'.
